weinberg_soft_graviton.source: Steven Weinberg, Phys. Rev. 135 (1964) B1049, DOI 10.1103/PhysRev.135.B1049
weinberg_soft_graviton.imported_constraint: A massless spin-2 soft theorem forces universal gravitational coupling under the usual S-matrix assumptions.
weinberg_soft_graviton.closure_power_for_mtt: supports universality of TT response; does not select Pi_exact64

deser_self_interaction.source: S. Deser, General Relativity and Gravitation 1 (1970) 9-18; arXiv:gr-qc/0411023
deser_self_interaction.imported_constraint: Consistent self-interaction of a massless spin-2 gauge field reconstructs the Einstein-type nonlinear coupling.
deser_self_interaction.closure_power_for_mtt: supports GR recovery from TT spin-2 consistency; does not select finite support

kk_zero_mode_logic.source: Duff, Nilsson, Pope, Phys. Rept. 130 (1986) 1-142; KK compactification literature
kk_zero_mode_logic.imported_constraint: Low-energy four-dimensional gravitons arise from universal internal zero-mode data in compactification reductions.
kk_zero_mode_logic.closure_power_for_mtt: suggests B^*P_TT should be a universal coherent shadow; needs MTT finite sampling theorem

R1_universal_spin2_bookkeeping_selector.idea: Use massless spin-2 consistency plus MTT universal geometry coupling to show physical TT adjoint support must lie in the unique shared bookkeeping channel.
what_it_closes: universal TT coupling is not a tunable choice
gravity response cannot be assigned to a sector-specific gauge channel
R1_universal_spin2_bookkeeping_selector.remaining_gate: prove that the unique shared bookkeeping channel, when restricted to the selected exact finite carrier, is exactly Pi_exact64 and not a different coherent subchannel

R2_equivariant_central_character_selecto.idea: Treat B^*P_TT as an equivariant co-shape map for the same central U(1) angle that rotates TT plus/cross. Finite sampling on the selected exact Z64 carrier then forces the k=2/k=62 real character plane by the existing uniqueness theorem.
what_it_closes: replaces the vague support premise by a precise equivariance premise
uses the already closed Z64 uniqueness theorem without adding a scalar knob
R2_equivariant_central_character_selecto.remaining_gate: source or prove same-angle equivariance: B^*P_TT must intertwine TT helicity rotations with the central-circle action used by the exact Z64 shift

R3_zero_mode_shadow_plus_finite_helicity.idea: Use KK/MTT zero-mode logic for the external graviton and keep helicity as a separate central-circle character. External zero-mode status removes KK momentum; finite helicity sampling selects k=2 on Z64.
what_it_closes: prevents confusion between external/KK zero-mode and central-circle helicity k=2
explains why k=2 support need not contradict low-energy zero-mode recovery
R3_zero_mode_shadow_plus_finite_helicity.remaining_gate: prove the selected zero-mode shadow is carried by the exact central-circle fiber rather than merely by an abstract coherent subspace

R4_string_closed_bookkeeping_analogy.idea: Use the closed-string massless spin-2/global-bookkeeping analogy as a selection heuristic: gravity is the global consistency mode, not a localized gauge-sector excitation.
what_it_closes: motivates why the final support should be a global shared carrier
helps reject sector-local lens/nil-only closures as proof sources for TT support
R4_string_closed_bookkeeping_analogy.remaining_gate: analogy is not a theorem; still needs R2 or direct DG(Psi*) computation

R5_direct_matrix_reconstruction.idea: Build the finite co-shape matrix from constraints: nonzero TT adjoint support, BRST quotient, central equivariance, exact d_* branch, and orthonormal TT basis. Then verify Pi_exact64 B^*P_TT = B^*P_TT by matrix multiplication.
what_it_closes: turns the proof into a reproducible finite certificate
would close the last gate if the equivariant input matrix is sourced rather than fitted
R5_direct_matrix_reconstruction.remaining_gate: the selected entries of DG(Psi*) or its equivariant normalization are not in the corpus

best_route.name: R2_equivariant_central_character_selector
best_route.why: It is the narrowest real proof obligation: no new numerical parameter, no appeal to observed gravity data, and it exactly targets the independence no-go by adding the missing structural fact instead of a scalar fit.
best_route.statement: On the selected exact GR/QG branch, the adjoint TT co-shape map B^*P_TT is equivariant for the central-circle U(1) action that rotates TT plus/cross with helicity weight 2, and the selected finite carrier of that action is the exact Z64 d_* branch.
best_route.immediate_consequence: Pi_exact64 B^*P_TT = B^*P_TT and support(J_TT)=|d_*> tensor span{c_2,s_2}; hence lambda_GR,TT=15 in normalized internal units.

decision.why_not_closed: The external literature closes universality and spin-2 consistency, while the MTT corpus closes helicity-2 Z64 uniqueness. The still missing statement is the equivariance/same-angle identification of the actual adjoint shape map B^*P_TT with the selected exact central action.
